item.title: US Treasury Yields Hit Two-Month Low as Tech Stocks Extend Slide
item.description: Treasuries soared on Wednesday as a selloff in global equities over the sustainability of the AI trade prompted investors to rush into the safety of US government debt.

item.title: Netflix Buys Seinfeld Studio Lot After Goldman Forecloses
item.description: Bloomberg's John Gittelsohn joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Netflix announced it’s buying Radford Studio Center, the historic Los Angeles lot where Seinfeld was filmed, for $380 million after Goldman Sachs Group took control of the property. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Blue Owl, Blackstone Make Rare Pension Deal
item.description: Bloomberg's Layan Odeh joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." A top US pension is considering raising roughly $4 billion in a complex financing bundling stakes in private credit funds managed by Blackstone, Blue Owl Capital and others, according to people familiar with the matter. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Sanofi’s $41B Insmed Deal Shows Cost of a Patent Cliff
item.description: Bloomberg's Naomi Kresge joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Sanofi shares climbed on Wednesday to the highest since May 2025, adding to yesterday’s strong gains following the announcement of its planned acquisition of US drugmaker Insmed. Sanofi received a few Wall Street upgrades after the deal. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 25
item.description: Oil rose in thin trading as escalating attacks in the Middle East clouded the recovery in crude shipments from the region in recent months.
